hooks.name: Kiro journal entry
hooks.description: At the end of each agent session, append a short evidence entry used later for the Kiro usage write-up.

action.prompt:
Append exactly one entry to docs/kiro-journal.md (create it if missing) in this format:
## <ISO date> — <surface: IDE|CLI|Web|Crew>
- Spec task(s): <ids or 'none (vibe)'>
- What Kiro did: <1 line>
- What the human corrected: <1 line>
- Kiro feature used: <specs/hooks/steering/agent/MCP/PBT/power>
Keep it factual and under 6 lines.
